fixed.summary: Grass under a shadowed point or spot light draws faster: its blades read that light's shadow through a 2x2 filter instead of the 8x8 contact-hardening one other surfaces use (a blade is narrower than a shadow texel, and a field breaks the edge up anyway). About 1.2 ms of a 2560x1440 frame on The Last Light; the grass looks the same.
